prompt:
Create TC-SKIN-A2 / Fine Fibres and Plain Weave repair board for the SAME town_center skin pilot. Fundamental material-content correction: the earlier straw and cloth images are rejected because they read as branching tree bark and a random circuit maze. Produce TWO NEW raster image assets with genuinely different fine structures; do not reuse, recolor, crop or relabel any of the earlier material images. Leave all existing screens/master artwork intact. Reuse the existing project design system.

PLATFORM: Desktop static material-source review, no gameplay.

PAGE STRUCTURE:
1. Brief title and "new material candidates / no runtime integration".
2. Exactly two independent full-bleed square original raster material images with labels only outside:
 A. thatch_fiber_microdetail_v3. A uniformly lit flat close-up surface of hundreds of very thin dry reed/straw fibres packed alongside one another, almost all running straight vertically. Each strand occupies roughly 2-6 image pixels at native 1024px width. Tiny papery splits, short broken ends and fine closely spaced linear highlights. NO broad dark branches, looping cracks, tree growth-ring knots, wood-bark channels or horizontally stepped sheaves. No roof picture, tied bundle, rope, slab, border or frame. This is the minute straw grain on the existing town_center roof, not another structural thatch-roof illustration.
 B. civic_banner_plain_weave_v3. A uniformly lit flat close-up surface of fine plain-woven dyed linen: many very small regular vertical threads and horizontal threads crossing at right angles in an even alternating over-under checker weave. Approximate thread spacing 4-8 image pixels at 1024px. Each crossing is a tiny regular yarn bump, with small natural thread variation. The grid remains fine and continuous. NO maze, circuit traces, broken random rectangular paths, decorative tartan, lace, symbols, giant weave gaps, loops, frayed silhouette, banner picture, pole or folds. Quiet low-contrast fabric microdetail; it must look woven rather than printed.
3. Below the two images show tiny reference-only crops of the town_center roof and banner from BLDG-01 if available, without baking those reference crops inside the swatches.
4. Minimal ID and direction metadata.

SOURCE REQUIREMENTS:
- Make actual newly generated raster images for BOTH surface descriptions, 1024x1024, separate downloadable sources. CSS gradients/patterns/SVG placeholders are unacceptable.
- Orthogonal straight-on view, no perspective, no thickness, no drop shadow, no presentation background, no vignette or text inside pixels. The material fills every edge.
- Follow the illustrated microtexture craftsmanship of the BLDG-01 town_center (architecture IMAGE screen 5eaec90d6212477cb95917458d523044), preserving the established material family and restrained small pixel clusters; not photographs or glossy renders. Avoid the coarse chunky pattern scale of the rejected candidates.
- The two assets must be visibly different from the previous rejected bark and labyrinth images. Do not claim success if the pixel content was merely reused. No animation, website navigation or other asset families.
